items.title: Threat Actors Exploit OpenVSX Aqua Trivy with Malicious AI Prompts to Hijack Local Coding Tools
items.description: A supply chain attack targeting developers surfaced on March 2, 2026, when unauthorized code was found inside two versions of the Aqua Trivy VS Code extension on the OpenVSX registry. The compromised versions — 1.8.12 and 1.8.13 — were uploaded on February 27 and 28, 2026, under the aquasecurityofficial.trivy-vulnerability-scanner namespace. The attack introduced hidden natural-language prompts…

items.title: Hackers Leveraged CyberStrikeAI Tool to Breach Fortinet FortiGate Devices
items.description: A new artificial intelligence (AI) offensive security tool called CyberStrikeAI, which is being actively leveraged by threat actors to target edge devices, particularly Fortinet FortiGate appliances. This open-source platform, developed by a China-based individual with potential ties to state-sponsored operations, represents a significant escalation in the weaponization of AI for cyber attacks.…

items.title: Android Security Update – Patch for 129 Vulnerabilities and Actively Exploited Zero-Day
items.description: Google has released its highly anticipated March 2026 Android Security Bulletin, delivering critical fixes for 129 security vulnerabilities across the Android ecosystem. This massive update represents one of the highest numbers of patches issued in a single month in recent years. items.title: CyberStrikeAI tool adopted by hackers for AI-powered attacks
items.description: Researchers warn that a newly identified open-source AI security testing platform called CyberStrikeAI was used by the same threat actor behind a recent campaign that breached hundreds of Fortinet FortiGate firewalls. [...]

items.title: The Tug-of-War Over Firewall Backlogs in the AI-Driven Development Era
items.description: Speed and security are historically clashing priorities, but with AI and automation, it's increasingly important that application developers and security teams get on the same page.
